analyst_view.overall: Ajax (11th of 36, 6 points) host FC Thun (19th, 3 points), and the numbers make Ajax big favourites after their 6-1 win at Midtjylland earlier in the league phase. Thun are struggling at home: 9th of 12 in the Swiss Super League, and they lost the Bern derby 2-3 at Young Boys on Saturday. Ajax travel to Feyenoord for De Klassieker on Sunday 29 November, three days after this game, so some changes to the Ajax side are likely, and a team-news site also expects Thun to rotate before their own league game. Striker Kasper Dolberg has been out with a torn cruciate ligament since early October, which the recent form the numbers use already reflects; no referee is named yet. I take a little off the goal and shot numbers for the expected Ajax rotation and leave the rest alone.

goals.text: The numbers say 4.2 goals, 3.2 of them for Ajax, and they already add a little for Ajax's 16 goals in their last six. With De Klassieker at Feyenoord three days later, Ajax are likely to rest some starters, so I trim 4%, to about 4.0 goals. Dolberg's long injury is not new and is already in their recent form.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.2 corners, mostly Ajax (6.4) against a Thun side expected to defend deep. Rotation changes who plays more than how Ajax play, as they will still have most of the ball against a weaker side. I stay at 9.2.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.3 cards, with Thun expected to pick up more of them (2.7) chasing the ball. No referee has been named and nothing I read changes the picture; both sides' recent card counts are already in the numbers. I stay at 4.3.

shots.text: The numbers say 31.0 shots, about 20 of them from Ajax. A changed Ajax side three days before Feyenoord away usually means a slightly lower tempo once the game is won, so I take off 3%, to about 30.1 shots.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.8 shots on target, with Ajax's recent sharpness already adding a little. For the same rotation reason I trim 3%, to about 9.5 shots on target. Thun's attack has been weak in Switzerland, which the numbers already know from their form.
